categories.name: intent
categories.description: What the customer is primarily trying to accomplish with this message.

labels.description: The customer is reporting something that is broken or behaving incorrectly.
The customer is asking for new functionality that does not yet exist.
The customer is asking how to do something with the existing product.
The message concerns payments, invoices, refunds, or subscriptions.
The customer is expressing dissatisfaction without a specific actionable request.

categories.name: sentiment
categories.description: The overall emotional tone the customer expresses.

labels.description: The customer is satisfied, appreciative, or friendly.
The message is factual or transactional with no strong emotion.
The customer is frustrated, angry, or disappointed.

categories.name: urgency
categories.description: How time-sensitive the request appears to be.

labels.description: The customer would like a response soon but is not blocked.
The customer is blocked or describes a business-critical impact.
